description: Whitelist of commands the teacher may send to clients. To add or remove commands, edit this file and release an update — the update pipeline distributes the new whitelist to every client.

wallpaper.description: Set the enforced wallpaper path on every client.

configMode.description: Toggle the wallpaper guard on every client: on = enforce the locked wallpaper (default), off = let students change their wallpaper again.

lan-only.description: Cut external (internet) access — LAN-only mode. Requires the firewall helper installed via install.sh -f. Release with on=false.

fw-status.description: Query the client's firewall lock state (requires the firewall helper).

update.description: Update every client to a new version (URL must be HTTPS, SHA-256 required).
